name: Nexoy Order Tracker for WooCommerce
author: Rayhan Chowdhury

sections.description:
Nexoy Order Tracker for WooCommerce is an agency-grade, premium order tracking solution designed to give your customers a luxury post-purchase experience.

Instead of default, boring WooCommerce tracking pages, Nexoy Order Tracker provides a smooth, AJAX-powered, beautiful vertical timeline UI that seamlessly integrates with your WordPress theme.

🚀 Premium Features:

  • Luxury Timeline UI: A beautifully designed, modern vertical timeline that shows the exact journey of an order.
  • AJAX Powered: Customers can track their orders instantly without reloading the page.
  • Email or Phone Tracking: Users can track orders using their Order ID combined with either their Billing Email or Billing Phone.
  • Courier Info & Tracking Link: Easily add courier names and third-party tracking URLs from the order backend.
  • Smart Auto-Logging: The plugin automatically logs every WooCommerce order status change with an exact timestamp.
  • Dark & Light Mode: Choose between a clean Light theme or a premium Dark theme directly from the settings.
  • 100% Responsive: Pixel-perfect design that looks stunning on mobile devices and native apps.
  • Shortcode Integration: Works flawlessly on any page or post using a simple shortcode [nexoy_order_tracker].

👨‍💻 Developed By

Built with passion by The Nexoy Agency (https://thenexoy.com).
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Nexoy Order Tracker (or upload the downloaded .zip file).
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Nexoy Order Tracker to configure your visual settings (Light/Dark mode).
  5. Copy the shortcode [nexoy_order_tracker] and paste it onto any page (e.g., “Track Order” page) to display the tracker.
sections.faq:
Where can I display the tracking form?

You can display the tracker on any page or post by pasting the [nexoy_order_tracker] shortcode into your text editor.

Does the customer need to log in to track the order?

No. Customers can track their orders simply by providing their Order ID and their Billing Email or Phone number. No account creation is required.

Can I add third-party courier tracking links?

Absolutely. Inside every WooCommerce order edit page, you will find a “Nexoy Order Tracker” meta box where you can input the Courier Name and Tracking URL.
